research_question: Does the descriptive 4.3 micron CO2-band contrast remain below 3 sigma across declared wavelength-window choices, and is MIRI non-flatness robust to deletion of any one published bin?

hypotheses.nir_null: Every declared CO2-band/continuum contrast has absolute diagonal-error significance below 3 sigma.
hypotheses.miri_null: A constant-depth MIRI model is rejected at alpha=0.05 after every leave-one-bin-out refit.

miri_overlap_rule: Retain MIRI bins whose central wavelength is greater than the maximum NIRISS+NIRSpec wavelength.
